page.title: Brünnelistock, Rossälplispitz and Zindlenspitz (2097 m) -- Hike Plan

hero.subtitle_html: Wägitalersee, P. 932 -> Brünnelistock, Rossälplispitz and Zindlenspitz -- SAC T5 | ~1432 m gain | ~11.3 km | ~4h30

intro_html: A spectacular three-summit ridge traverse between the Wägital and Glarus. Starting from Wägitalersee, the route links Brünnelistock (2132 m), Rossälplispitz (2075 m) and Zindlenspitz (2097 m) — one of the great classics of the region. The crux is the exposed ridge to Brünnelistock (T5−); the rest ranges from T3 to T4 with fixed ropes and chains.

bullets_html: P. 931 via Hohfläsch-Hütte (1368 m) to Hohfläschenmatt (1687 m) — 2 h 15 min
Hohfläschenmatt to saddle P. 1989 — narrow, slightly exposed ledges without scrambling
Detour to Brünnelistock (2132 m) — exposed ridge, no belaying possibilities (T5−, crux)
Saddle P. 1989 to Rossälplispitz (2075 m) — fixed ropes on rocky summit slope (T3+)
Rossälplispitz to Zindlenspitz (2097 m) via P. 1979 — steep rocky outcrop with chain (T4−), easy scrambling before summit

getting_there.by_pt_html: Bus to Innerthal, Gemeindeplatz, then ~45 min on foot along the road to P. 932. Alternatives: rent a bike at Gasthaus Stausee (055 446 12 79), boat taxi via waegitalersee.ch (055 446 13 44), Alpentaxi, or Mobility from Siebnen-Wangen station.
getting_there.by_car_html: Drive to Wägitalersee east shore. A few parking spaces at the Fläschloch cable car valley station, ~500 m past P. 932.

weather.season_html: June–October when snow-free. Do not undertake in wet conditions — exposed rock becomes dangerous.

takeaways_html: Exposed ridge to Brünnelistock: Multiple reports emphasise the exposed, unprotected ridge between P. 1989 and Brünnelistock as the crux (T5−). No fixed ropes or chains — sure-footedness and a head for heights are essential.

Fixed aids on Rossälplispitz and Zindlenspitz: Long iron chain/fixed rope on the steep ascent to Rossälplispitz; additional chain after the saddle at P. 1901. Reporters note these help significantly but should not be relied upon blindly.
Outstanding panorama: Across reports, the 360° views from all three summits — Wägitalersee, Glärnisch, Sihlsee, and into Glarus — are consistently described as the highlight of the tour.

reports.title: Zindlenspitz, Rossalpelispitz und Brünnelistock — eine lohnende Trilogie
bullets_html: Classic three-summit traverse from Wägitalersee; ridge becomes increasingly exposed approaching Brünnelistock with light scrambling moves.
Magnificent summit views; descent via Hohfläschenmatt takes ~2 h back to the car.

reports.title: Brünnelistock, Rossalpelispitz & Zindlenspitz
bullets_html: Rocky step to the saddle overcome in zigzag with occasional hand use; damp-slippery conditions noted on shoe soles.
Full Wägitaler Trilogie completed in good weather; described as one of the great classics of the region.

reports.title: Grattour Zindlenspitz bis Brünnelistock
bullets_html: Dry ridge conditions; forecast thunderstorms did not materialise. Hot for the season.
Zindlenspitz approach rated T3; difficulty increases significantly on the Brünnelistock ridge traverse.
